name: export_stl
description: Export selected FreeCAD solids to an STL file under a fixed fixture_exports/ directory. path is a filename only (e.g. remote.stl); separators are rejected. When object_names is omitted, all document solids are exported.

object_names.description: Document object names to export. Omit to export all solids.

path.description: Filename only under fixture_exports/; no directories or separators.
